newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Breakaway Somaliland votes for new flag.
newsitem.headline: Breakaway Somaliland votes for new flag.

text.p: The breakaway Republic of Somaliland has a new national flag unlikely to be flown officially outside its territory because it has no international recognition.

A national conference voted on Monday for the new flag of three horizontal stripes of green, white and red with a black star in the middle. "There is no God but Allah and Mohammad is his prophet," appears in Arabic script on the green stripe.
The new flag replaces one which was white with a green circle in the centre with the same Arabic script around it.
Somaliland with its capital in Hargeisa in northwestern Somalia covers the area of the former British Somaliland, which joined with Italian-ruled Somalia in 1960 to form the republic of Somalia.
It broke away from Somalia at the start of the Somali civil war in 1991 but has failed to secure any foreign recognition.
